ambition: By 2032, the number of smokers is reduced to 5% of adults and 0% of young people and pregnant women
By 2032, pregnant women and under-18s do not drink alcohol; among adults, 65% do not drink alcohol or no more than one glass a day
By 2032, the number of people applying safe sun behaviour advice will have increased by at least 15%
By 2032, infections with the HPV virus, and other infectious diseases that can lead to cancer, are prevented as much as possible
By 2032, people are less exposed to environmental and air pollution
By 2032, people eat healthier and exercise enough
By 2032, people who may have a hereditary predisposition can make informed choices for hereditary testing
By 2032, disadvantages and barriers to participating in early cancer detection are reduced
By 2032, people with cancer will have a personalised diagnosis (more) quickly with minimal burden
By 2032, people with cancer will have access to the best possible personalised treatment with minimal burden
By 2032, innovative and effective diagnostic and treatment methods are more readily available
By 2032, survival and quality of life of people with or after a rare form of cancer has improved
By 2032, people with incurable cancer will receive proactive palliative care and support based on their values, wishes and needs
By 2032, people with or after cancer are supported to maintain or acquire a healthy(er) lifestyle
By 2032, good care and support is available for people who live with or after cancer to prevent and reduce the impact of the (late) effects of cancer
By 2032, people living with or after cancer can be educated according to their own wishes, needs and coping ability
By 2032, people living with or after cancer will be able to work according to their own wishes, needs and ability to cope
By 2032, people living with or after cancer experience as few negative financial consequences as possible
By 2032, care and support for loved ones and informal caregivers is available
In 2032, people with or after cancer and their loved ones feel socially and emotionally supported by society
